seed_policy.what_gets_seeded: Every entry is normalized into an Item(type=tool) catalog record named 'Official: <vendor>'. Items are matched on canonical_id 'official:<id>' so re-running the seeder updates in place and never duplicates.
seed_policy.testable_rule: testable == (mcp_url contains no {placeholder} and not platform_excluded). REGION_SPECIFIC URLs with the region pinned in the URL itself (AWS, LangSmith EU/AWS, Customer.io EU) are dialable as-is and stay testable; TENANT_SPECIFIC/STORE_SPECIFIC/TEMPLATE entries carry a {placeholder} that only the user's account can fill, so they surface in search but are not auto-testable.
seed_policy.search_ranking: These items carry provider='official_connectors' so ranking can promote them above registry/GitHub results for the same service.
seed_policy.platform_excluded: Entries whose operator is a third-party gateway/aggregator already rejected by the verification prefilter (WayStation, Rube/Composio, Zapier hosted gateway) are kept here for completeness but are NOT seeded as testable items.

field_notes.auth_kind: Normalized auth family: none | api_key | oauth2 | oauth_or_api_key | unknown (derived from the free-form auth_type)
field_notes.oauth_flow: authorization_code for consent-screen providers; api_key when a static token is the documented path
field_notes.testable: Whether the URL can be dialed as-is: false only when the URL contains a {placeholder} (tenant/store/API-key) or the operator is platform-excluded
field_notes.caution: Presence in a directory does not guarantee the endpoint is currently live or speaks MCP correctly. The platform still verifies before production use.
